popup.noise.monitoringNote: This value is the energy average of the samples actually reported within the latest available 30-day window; it is not a complete continuous monthly mean, a nationally synchronized month, or a regulatory compliance finding. Stations without a value are kept; no value does not mean 0 dB or quiet.
popup.noise.captureNote: NoiseCapture / Noise-Planet citizen-science observations, not statutory noise measurements. The grid is a rolling 365 days and highly sparse; blank map areas do not mean quiet or 0 dB.
popup.noise.repairedYes: Yes (topology repair of the original official geometry)
popup.noise.zoneNote: Classes 1 to 4 are statutory noise-control categories, not measured loudness. v1 covers Taichung only; topology repair does not mean the statutory boundary was redrawn or estimated.
popup.noise.aviationNote: This map overlays the announced village list on administrative boundaries; it is not a measured DNL noise contour and does not mean every spot in a village has the same aircraft noise. v1 covers Taoyuan and Kaohsiung only.
popup.noise.enforcementNote: This point shows an official noise penalty event and fine; it is not a dB observation, sound intensity or a live enforcement location.
popup.noise.equipmentNotProvided: Not provided by the source (not a live status)
popup.noise.listMeaningValue: Equipment / enforcement road section from the official list (not a penalty event or dB)
popup.noise.cameraNote: This is equipment / an enforcement road section from the official list; it does not indicate live activation status, violation locations or dB. Road-section and fuzzy locations must not be read as exact equipment points.
